inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Scheduled Task Leading to DLL Sideloading from Suspicious Paths

properties.description: Detects the creation of a scheduled task that launches an executable from a non-standard, writable directory, which subsequently loads a co-located DLL. This pattern is a form of DLL Sideloading used for persistence and was observed in a ToddyCat APT attack.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Scheduled Task Leading to DLL Sideloading from Suspicious Paths
properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
// Define suspicious, commonly world-writable paths where applications shouldn't typically be installed for persistence.
let suspiciousPaths = dynamic([
    @"C:\ProgramData\",
    @"C:\Users\Public\",
    @"C:\PerfLogs\",
    @"C:\Windows\Temp\",
    @"C:\Temp\"
]);
// Find processes launched from suspicious locations that load a DLL from the same directory (sideloading).
let SideloadEvents =
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll" and isnotempty(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
    // The core sideloading condition: process path is the same as the loaded module path.
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath == FolderPath
    // Focus on suspicious, non-standard paths.
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (suspiciousPaths)
    | project
        SideloadTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        SideloadingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
        SideloadingProcessPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
        LoadedDll = FileName,
        ReportId,
        InitiatingProcessId;
// Find scheduled task creations that point to executables in these suspicious locations.
let SchTaskCreations =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback * 2) // Look back a bit further for the task creation.
    | where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "/create" and ProcessCommandLine has "/tr"
    // Extract the executable path from the /tr argument. Handles both quoted and unquoted paths.
    | extend QuotedTaskPath = extract("(?i)/tr\\s+\"([^\"]+)\"", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend UnquotedTaskPath = extract("(?i)/tr\\s+([^\\s\"]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend TaskExecutablePath = iif(isnotempty(QuotedTaskPath), QuotedTaskPath, UnquotedTaskPath)
    | where isnotempty(TaskExecutablePath)
    // Focus on tasks pointing to executables in the same suspicious paths.
    | where TaskExecutablePath has_any (suspiciousPaths)
    | project
        SchTaskTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        TaskCreator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
        SchtaskCommandLine = ProcessCommandLine,
        TaskExecutablePath;
// Join the two event types to find scheduled tasks that lead to DLL sideloading.
SideloadEvents
| join kind=inner (
    SchTaskCreations
) on DeviceId
// Match the executable path from the scheduled task with the full path of the process that performed the sideload.
| where strcat(SideloadingProcessPath, SideloadingProcess) == TaskExecutablePath
// Ensure the task was created before the sideloading event occurred, within our lookback window.
| where SideloadTime > SchTaskTime and (SideloadTime - SchTaskTime) < lookback
| project
    Timestamp = SideloadTime,
    DeviceName,
    SideloadingProcess,
    SideloadingProcessPath,
    LoadedDll,
    SchtaskCommandLine,
    TaskCreator,
    SchTaskTime
